A caption is treated as a named civic building's caption when its TEXT names a civic group word (ministry, governor, temple); then every other named civic building keeps full weight
decisions.why: The rule as stated now matches FR-014, but its detection does not: answer 070 withholds the waiver only from 'a named civic building's caption - a ministry by name, the governor's yamen, a temple by name', and grants a district caption 'any building of that district'. Keying on a civic group WORD in the text classes a district caption such as 'temple neighborhood' (a caption 070 itself names) or an unnamed temple's generic 'temple' caption as a named civic building's caption, so it may not lie on the named temples of its own district - the case the plan's next sentence says it allows. Nothing prevents keying on the caption's SUBJECT being a named civic record (the Obstacle already carries named=True).

decisions.summary: seat-label writes, moves or removes leaders; --check and the ledger test check them
Hand-sheet shapes classified by data-kind: road/river/revetment ways; '-' and any kind 'naming a court, garden, ground, yard, grove or pines' free; the rest obstacles - text elements included
decisions.why: Classifying by tag is right (round-1 item 3), but the rule as written makes two FR-006 obstacles free. (a) 'court divider' names a court by the plan's word test, and it is a wall: <g stroke-width=6 data-kind="court divider"> on hayakawa (line 241), ochiba (152), ubame (135) and county-magistracy-example (93), measured 2026-09-27 by grep; FR-006 weighs a wall 1,000. (b) The plan classes EVERY shape by its tag, text included, so another caption tagged with a ground kind is free space: county-magistracy-example line 9 <text data-kind="garden">garden</text>, ubame line 554 'inner garden' inside <g data-kind="garden">, and every court's caption; so is the '-' title and scale-bar text. FR-006 weighs another caption 1,000, and the settlement adaptor already treats the title placard as an obstacle. Nothing makes the literal rule impossible.

decisions.summary: The tool and the ledger gate find a hand sheet's captions only as <text> inside or carrying a data-kind tag
decisions.why: FR-013: the gate test MUST hold EVERY hand-drawn sheet, and D9 names the country shrine as re-seated when next revised. hoshigaoka-shrine.svg carries ZERO data-kind attributes (grep -c, 2026-09-27) and 16 <text> elements, so under this rule the tool finds no captions on it and the gate, once the shrine is revised and its ledger exemption lapses, passes it with every caption off-seat. The plan's premise (research.md R3: 'Every drawn element carries a data-kind tag (feature 262)') is true of the magistracy sheets, not the shrine. Tagging the shrine before the ledger is taken, or failing the gate on an untagged non-title <text> of a changed sheet, reaches it.
